pages.title: Newton's Fruit Fusion
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Newton's Fruit Fusion is a dropping-and-merging puzzle about creating larger fruits. Use the mouse or touchpad to release fruit, bringing matching kinds together so they combine into a bigger one.

Consider where each fruit will land before dropping it. Arranging matching pieces near one another helps you continue the chain of merges and work toward the largest fruit you can create. The challenge comes from planning those placements as the collection develops.

pages.title: Turnline Atelier
pages.creator: extenup
pages.description:
Turnline Atelier puts you in charge of routing workpieces through a precision workshop. Click or tap the round modules to rotate them, connecting the starting point to the required stations and final destination. Follow the recipe's order through operations such as painting, cutting, assembly and packing, then press Run to check the result.

The game contains fifteen commissions across three chapters. Later orders introduce split routes, offcuts that need preserving and parts that must reach the correct assembly sockets or bins. Trace each branch before running the machinery so that its workpieces arrive at the right station in the right sequence.

pages.title: Tap 3D Blocks
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description:
Tap 3D Blocks asks you to examine a layered structure of dice and work out which pieces can leave it. Find dice with arrows pointing outward from the center, then remove them to create space and uncover more of the puzzle.

Rotate the structure to inspect sides that are hidden from your current view. Boosters provide several ways to get help: Turn Back undoes a move, Shuffle rearranges dice, Hint points you toward a choice, and Hammer removes a selected die. Look at the newly exposed pieces after each removal before choosing the next one.

pages.title: FlowBall
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description:
FlowBall sends a glowing ball through a tunnel filled with traps, obstacles and gaps. Guide it past the hazards while collecting glowing dots to unlock further levels and improve your record. Falling into a chasm costs a life, and running out of lives ends the attempt.

On a computer, use the arrow keys to maneuver left and right. Touch controls let you tap or swipe sideways to move and swipe forward to accelerate. Watch the next section of tunnel before changing position, especially when a gap interrupts an otherwise clear route.

pages.title: Hexa GO!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Hexa GO! is a directional tile puzzle with the goal of dropping every hexagon off the grid. Click a tile and it rolls in the direction shown by its arrow. Work out which directions let the pieces leave and which moves help clear the rest of the arrangement.

Special tiles add other ways to alter the board. Bombs explode nearby tiles, while the rotate button swaps tiles. Check the arrow directions after making a change so that you can plan the next part of the clearance.

pages.title: Italian Brainrot Find the Stars
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Italian Brainrot Find the Stars hides twelve stars in each illustrated scene. Use the mouse or touch screen to mark the stars you find, searching the whole picture before the timer expires. There are twelve levels to complete.

Repeated incorrect selections take an extra five seconds off the remaining time. Look closely before tapping a suspicious detail so that a rushed guess does not reduce the time available for the stars still hidden in the image.

pages.title: Natural disaster survival Obby
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description:
Natural disaster survival Obby combines obstacle-course movement with maps threatened by disasters. Move around lava, floods, tornadoes and other hazards, trying to remain alive while the environment becomes dangerous. The game includes multiplayer play and unlockable character skins and pets.

Use WASD to move, Space to jump and the mouse to look around. Tab shows or hides the cursor. On a phone, move with the left joystick, jump with the right button and swipe to turn the camera. Check the changing hazards as you navigate the map and choose where to move next.

pages.title: Robot Runner Fight
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description:
Robot Runner Fight sends a robot across parkour platforms in a futuristic city. Run toward the finish, avoid the obstacles in the route and fight the enemies that get in the way.

Use mouse clicks or taps to play. The course combines movement challenges with combat, so watch the next platform and the opponents ahead as you progress. Your objective is to bring the robot through those encounters and reach the end of the run.

pages.title: Screw Jam - Fun Puzzle Game
pages.creator: FunFox Games
pages.description:
Screw Jam - Fun Puzzle Game is a dismantling puzzle about removing boards by taking out their screws. Choose the order carefully, untwist the screws and put them into the appropriate screw boxes. Completing every screw set finishes the level.

Look at how the screws and boards relate before removing the next piece.

pages.title: Cleaning Simulator
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
Cleaning Simulator gives you a collection of objects to clean, with twelve parts covering subjects such as sports cars, electronics and everyday items. Click or tap to carry out the cleaning activities and work on the object shown in the current part.

The game uses 2D presentations of recognizable objects.

pages.title: Ropeway Master
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description:
Ropeway Master is a rescue puzzle in which you draw a safe rope route for a group of people. Drag the rope into position, finding a path that brings everyone through the scene without meeting its obstacles.

Use the mouse or touch controls to arrange the route. Examine the hazards before committing the rope to a path, considering the whole journey. Complete the rescue by getting everyone safely through the level.

pages.title: ASMR Washing & Fixing
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description:
ASMR Washing & Fixing puts you in a 3D cleaning scene with a choice of tools. Pick a tool and one of five levels, then move around the space and use the equipment to work on the cleaning task.

On a computer, click and drag with the mouse; on mobile, tap and slide. Your position and the tool's use are both part of interacting with the scene. Adjust where you are working as you continue cleaning the selected level.

pages.title: Gangster Hero Open World Crime Shooting
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description:
Gangster Hero Open World Crime Shooting takes place in a city where you fight mafia enemies and complete action missions. Explore on foot, drive cars or ride motorcycles, and choose from weapons including pistols, machine guns and sniper rifles.

WASD moves the character, Space jumps and Shift runs. Aim with the right mouse button, fire with the left, switch weapons with Q and crouch with C. F enters or leaves a vehicle. Move between city exploration, driving and armed encounters as you work through the missions.

pages.title: Eat The Fish IO
pages.creator: Rocket Studio
pages.description:
Eat The Fish IO puts you in an arena as a fish armed with a sharp blade. Steer toward opponents and attack from their sides or behind, keeping clear of the pointed end of their own weapons. Feeding helps your fish grow and recover the mana used for boosting.

Guide the fish with one finger and use the button on the right to increase its speed. The game includes multiplayer competition and a leaderboard. Watch the direction of nearby blades before making an approach so that your attack does not carry you into an opponent's weapon.

pages.title: Motocross Driving Simulator
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description:
Motocross Driving Simulator puts you on a motorcycle for rides and driving missions. Use WASD to control the bike and move the mouse to look around the surroundings as you travel.

Turn the camera to inspect the area around the bike before choosing your route through the riding challenge.

pages.title: Bakery Shop
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description:
Bakery Shop casts you as a pastry chef filling customer orders. Mix and decorate treats, then match the finished baked goods to what each customer requested. Click or tap to carry out the baking activities.

Look at an order before working on its treat so that your choices contribute to the required result. The task connects preparing the food with finishing its appearance and serving the right baked item to the waiting customer.

pages.title: High School BFFs Girls Team
pages.creator: ARPAPLUS
pages.description:
High School BFFs Girls Team is a dress-up game about styling a group of school friends. Choose their makeup and hair, then combine clothing such as shirts, jackets, skirts and hats to create the look you want for each girl.

Use the left mouse button to change outfit selections. You can work with school-uniform ideas or try other combinations from the wardrobe, coordinating the clothes with the hairstyle and makeup as you build each friend's appearance.

pages.title: Asphalt Retro
pages.creator: Gameloft SE
pages.description:
Asphalt Retro is a racing game with eight tracks and eight cars of increasing power. Race toward the leading positions while trying to avoid being busted along the way.

Use the Up arrow to boost the engine, and double-tap the Left or Right arrow to drift in that direction. Judge approaching turns before choosing when to drift so that you can carry the car through the route and continue the race. Different tracks and cars give you more racing challenges to work through.

pages.title: New Years Eve Cruise Party
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description:
New Years Eve Cruise Party is a dress-up game about preparing celebrities for a New Year's celebration at sea. Help them choose party outfits for their cruise, selecting the appearance you want them to wear for the evening.

Click with the left mouse button to make your choices. Compare the available costumes and put together each party look as the friends get ready to celebrate the new year aboard the ship.

pages.title: Garden Tales 3
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description:
Garden Tales 3 is a match-three puzzle adventure with Willy the gnome and a garden full of flowers, fruit and mushrooms. Swap pieces with the mouse or touch controls, making lines of at least three matching plants to remove them. Larger combinations produce extras that help with the board.

Advance along the saga map through increasingly difficult levels, using boosters when you need assistance. Daily Missions and the Daily Challenge offer coins and other rewards alongside the main levels. Follow the garden tasks while choosing matches that help clear the current arrangement and keep Willy's garden free of weeds.

pages.title: Rope Slash Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Rope Slash Online is a physics puzzle about releasing a ball so that it knocks down every can. Cut its supporting ropes in the right sequence, using the ball's movement to reach targets beyond obstacles.

On a computer, use the left mouse button to cut. On a phone or tablet, tap and slide across the rope. Moving platforms add another part of the route to consider. Look at where the ball will travel after a cut, then use the remaining ropes and scenery to finish clearing the cans.

pages.title: Toys Shooter You vs zombies
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Toys Shooter You vs zombies puts you up against an outbreak of toy zombies. Shoot the enemies to earn money, then spend it on weapons, attachments and character skins. Developing your equipment gives you another goal alongside stopping the zombies.

Move with WASD and look around with the mouse. The left mouse button fires, the right aims and the wheel changes weapons. R reloads, G throws a grenade and F picks up items. You can also run with Left Shift, crouch with Left Ctrl, go prone with X and jump with Space.

pages.title: Impostor Rush Rocket Launcher
pages.creator: KukoGames
pages.description:
Impostor Rush Rocket Launcher follows an impostor trying to escape an island watched by armed tower guards. Aim the launcher at the soldiers and fire rockets to defeat them as you work through the encounters.

Use the mouse to aim and shoot. On a touch screen, aim with a touch and release to fire. Check the guard's position and the height of the tower before choosing the shot's angle, then send the rocket toward the enemy blocking the escape.

pages.title: Monsters Memory
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Monsters Memory is a card-matching game with fifteen levels. Reveal a card, remember the monster pictured on it and find another card showing the same creature. Match every card on the board to complete the current level.

Use the mouse or touchpad to choose cards. Keep track of the monsters you have already uncovered so that a later reveal can lead you back to its partner. The task is clearing each arrangement by remembering where the matching pictures are hidden.

pages.title: Into Space 3
pages.creator: Barbarian Games
pages.description:
Into Space 3 turns a Christmas rescue into a series of rocket flights. Aliens have destroyed the gift factory and scattered its presents through the atmosphere. Launch a rocket to help the elves recover them, steering through the flight while watching the craft's fuel and condition.

Use the mouse or touch controls to play. Collect gifts and fuel during the journey, then develop the rocket through its parts and upgrades. Improving the craft supports further flights as you work toward recovering the stolen presents and saving Christmas while Santa is missing.

pages.title: Bitcoin Mining
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Bitcoin Mining is a clicker game about expanding a virtual Bitcoin-mining network. Use the mouse to develop the operation and increase its in-game earnings. Your goal is to keep growing the network as you progress.

pages.title: Tap Tap Colors
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description:
Tap Tap Colors combines tap-to-jump movement with shooting at colored blocks. The character fires automatically, while your taps adjust its height so you can line up shots and avoid colliding with the blocks ahead. Shots reduce the strength of the numbered targets.

Power-ups include 3 Bullets, Slow Speed and 1 Score. Collect them during the run and watch the next block arrangement before jumping again. Your task is to keep finding a way through while the character's shots work on clearing the route.

pages.title: Gladiator True Story
pages.creator: Xform
pages.description:
Gladiator True Story casts you as Bruticus in an arena full of enemy fighters and champions. Fight through their waves with melee attacks, upgrading armor and weapons as you develop the gladiator's combat strength.

Use WASD or the arrow keys to move. Z or the left mouse button attacks, with holding the attack allowing a charged strike. X or the right mouse button defends. Keep track of the fighters around Bruticus while choosing when to attack and when to protect yourself during the next encounter.

pages.title: Fall of Guyz Rocket Hero
pages.creator: TapTapking.com
pages.description:
Fall of Guyz Rocket Hero gives an armored character the task of defeating enemies stationed on towers. The opponents stand at different heights and shoot back, so aim the rocket launcher at the angle needed to reach each target.

Use the mouse to aim and fire, or play with touch controls on mobile. Judge the height and position of the next tower before taking a shot. Your task is to eliminate the villains threatening the city by landing rockets on their positions.

pages.title: 10x10 Gems Deluxe
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description:
10x10 Gems Deluxe is a block-placement puzzle played on a square grid. Drag the available shapes into place and complete a full row or column to remove it. Each clearance makes space for further blocks as you work toward a higher score.

The game ends when the remaining shapes have nowhere to fit. Consider the gaps left around a piece before placing it, since leaving useful space helps you keep playing. Look for placements that develop both a row and a column while accommodating the other shapes still waiting below the grid.

pages.title: John, the pirate
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description:
John, the pirate follows a treasure-seeking pirate into lands inhabited by strange creatures. Guide John through nine platforming levels and a boss encounter, using his pistol against the enemies along the route. Coins provide a way to earn extra lives.

Move with the arrow keys or W, A and D. Space, K or Z fires the pistol, while on-screen buttons provide the mobile controls. Watch the platforms and approaching creatures as you move, balancing progress through the level with the need to deal with enemies.

pages.title: Lock
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Lock is a timing puzzle played around a circle. Watch the yellow ball and orange bar, then tap when they line up. The ball can travel in either direction around the ring, so judge its movement before choosing your moment.

Keep making well-timed taps to improve your score. Focus on the point where the two markers meet as you prepare the next input.

pages.title: Archer Hero
pages.creator: Digi Smile limited
pages.description:
Archer Hero arms your character with a bow and an unlimited supply of arrows. Shoot the enemies that appear before their own attacks kill you. A headshot defeats an opponent immediately, making accurate aim useful alongside quick shooting.

Use the mouse on a computer or touch controls on mobile. Later levels put more enemies on screen together and make their shots more accurate. Choose your next target while watching the other attackers so that you can respond before their combined fire overwhelms the archer.

pages.title: Driver Highway
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Driver Highway challenges you to keep a car moving through traffic across three lanes. Change lanes to avoid the vehicles ahead, watching for moments when traffic occupies every lane and leaves a narrow opportunity to pass.

Steer with the arrow keys on a keyboard; on mobile, use a sliding gesture. Your speed increases the longer you remain in the game, giving you less time to react. Look beyond the nearest vehicle so that a lane change leaves room for the traffic coming after it.

pages.title: Block Stacking
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Block Stacking is a timing game about building a tower from blocks. Tap when the next block is in the position you want, placing it on the stack and trying to raise the tower as high as possible. Watch the placement before each tap so that you can continue building upward.

pages.title: Domie Love Pranking
pages.creator: Simplegame
pages.description:
Domie Love Pranking is a physics puzzle about using environmental effects to eliminate target egg characters. Select powers such as fire or hail and trigger their effects on the scene, working out how to reach all the targets. Protected eggs must remain safe: destroying one loses the level.

The game contains one hundred levels, and collected gold can buy different outfits. Click or tap to use the available props and abilities. Look at the targets, the protected characters and the surrounding objects before deciding how to set the effects in motion.

pages.title: TRZ Tangram
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description:
TRZ Tangram gives you geometric pieces to arrange into completed shapes. Drag each piece into the position where it belongs and rotate it when a different orientation is needed to fit the pattern.

The game includes thirty-nine tangram puzzles and a Free Mode for arranging pieces. Use the mouse or touch controls to move them. Compare the piece's outline with the space you want to fill before adjusting its angle and position.

pages.title: Spring Differences
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Spring Differences asks you to compare pairs of spring pictures and find the changes before time runs out. Click the details that differ, using the Hint button when you need help locating another one. Faster completion earns a higher score.

There are fifteen levels. The first three require five differences each, the next six require seven and the final six require ten. Check one area of both pictures at a time so that you can compare their details while keeping track of the remaining differences and time.

pages.title: Super Tank War
pages.creator: Mad Buffer
pages.description:
Super Tank War is a combat game about driving a tank against enemy bases. Find a way through the opposing defenses, attack their positions and collect coins that can be spent on tank upgrades.

The campaign contains more than seventy levels, with three player-tank types and ten kinds of enemy tank. Choose the tank you want to use and develop it with your earnings. Watch how the enemies respond as you approach a base, then look for a route that lets you bring the tank's attack to bear.

pages.title: Fruit Blade
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Fruit Blade is a fruit-slicing game about building the highest score. Swipe across oranges, kiwi, watermelon and other fruit to cut them. Cutting several fruits in a single motion creates a combo, which earns more points than separate cuts.

Watch for bombs mixed into the action and keep the blade away from them, since slicing one makes it explode. Judge the position of the fruit before swiping so that you can reach a group without cutting a bomb.

pages.title: Voodoo Doll
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Voodoo Doll is a puppet-hitting game with a collection of weapons to buy. Tap to attack the doll, then try different equipment as you expand the available selection. The puppet remains the target while your choice of weapon changes how you interact with it.

pages.title: Orc Hunter Halloween
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description:
Orc Hunter Halloween makes you a wizard defending a magical kingdom from approaching orcs. Tap in the direction you want to fire a magic projectile, aiming at the enemies threatening the kingdom.

There are thirty-six levels to play. Check where the orcs are before sending the next shot so that you can direct your magic toward them.

pages.title: Pixel Paintball Ruins Fun
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description:
Pixel Paintball Ruins Fun is an arena shooter with five modes, including gun game, wave survival and team deathmatch. It also includes offline play with a campaign of more than thirty levels. You begin offline with three guns, with additional weapons unlocked through rank progression.

Use WASD to move, Space to jump and Shift to run. The mouse handles looking around, aiming, shooting and weapon changes, while Tab opens the menu. Choose a mode and work through its combat encounters, developing your rank to increase the weapons available.

pages.title: Rum & Gun
pages.creator: Borington
pages.description:
Rum & Gun takes you onto the Indian Ocean as a pirate captain fighting rival pirates, wild animals and supernatural enemies. Move through the adventure with WASD or the arrow keys, using the left mouse button to attack and the right for melee combat.

Number keys or the mouse wheel switch weapons, R reloads and Q runs. The pirate's other actions include drinking rum with E, playing the fiddle with F and using a spell with Space. I opens or closes the inventory and P pauses the game. Manage the available weapons and actions as you deal with the enemies ahead.

pages.title: Powerful Wizards Hidden
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description:
Powerful Wizards Hidden asks you to find stars concealed in wizard illustrations. Click or tap the faint star shapes as you spot them, working through the picture before the timer runs out.

Watch the found counter to keep track of your progress. Search the scene's different areas carefully, including details where a star blends into the background. Complete the current picture's search to continue to another illustration and its hidden stars.

pages.title: Knife Hit Up
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description:
Knife Hit Up is a knife-throwing game built around rotating targets. Click or tap to launch a knife upward, aiming for an opening that lets it strike the target without hitting a knife or obstacle already attached to it. A collision with a barrier ends the attempt.

Land the required knives to complete the target and move through the stages, including boss encounters. Coins and the knife shop give you more blade designs to work toward. Watch the occupied sections as the target rotates before choosing the moment to throw.

pages.title: Goal keeper
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description:
Goal keeper puts you in front of a goal and asks you to stop incoming footballs. Click with the mouse or use touch controls to make catches, earning points by keeping the ball from going into the net.

The action speeds up as you play, giving you less time to respond to each shot. Conceding three balls ends the attempt, so watch the next ball and react before it gets past the goalkeeper.

pages.title: Hidden Burgers in Truck
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Hidden Burgers in Truck places ten concealed burgers in each food-truck picture. Examine the image and click every burger you discover, searching its details until you have found the full set.

The game contains six levels to complete. Check the trucks and the smaller objects around them for burger shapes. Finish the search in one picture to work on the next hidden-food arrangement.

pages.title: Delicious Food Collection
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
Delicious Food Collection is a chain-matching puzzle with food targets to collect before a timer expires. Press a food item and trace through neighboring pieces of the same kind, connecting at least three before releasing to make the match. Connections can run sideways, vertically or diagonally.

Selections longer than seven items provide extra time. Look for chains that include the foods requested by the level so that each move contributes to the collection goal. You need to meet that goal within the time available to continue.

pages.title: War Gun Commando
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description:
War Gun Commando puts a surrounded soldier into a firefight with enemy troops. Use your weapons to fight for a way out, making use of nearby objects for cover or as hazards you can turn against the attackers. Oil cans provide one such opportunity in the environment.

Aim with the right mouse button and fire with the left. R reloads and Tab pauses. Check both the enemy positions and the objects around them as you work through the confrontation and try to escape.

pages.title: Kick The Buddy 3D
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description:
Kick The Buddy 3D gives you a ragdoll puppet and a selection of weapons to use against it. Control the attacks with the mouse and try the different tools on the doll, watching how it reacts to their impacts.

The game includes weapon-purchase options and upgrades, with equipment such as blades and guns in the selection. Choose another attack as you develop the available arsenal and continue experimenting with the puppet in the 3D scene.

pages.title: Ice Cream Maker
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description:
Ice Cream Maker follows the preparation of frozen desserts from ingredients to decoration. Use the mouse to work through activities such as cutting fruit, mixing ingredients and freezing the mixture, then turn the result into an ice cream serving or an ice pop.

The preparation scenes include milk, cream, fruit and chocolate, with tools and containers for the different stages. Scoop ice cream into a serving, add decorations and customize the cup to finish its appearance. Follow the current activity's prompts before moving to the next part of making and decorating the dessert.

pages.title: Hunter Run
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description:
Hunter Run is a side-scrolling game in which the character runs automatically. Click to jump, avoiding bombs while collecting coins along the street and trying to reach the finish.

Time each jump around the hazards ahead so that the runner can continue down the route. Space or the pause button stops the action when you need a break. The task combines reaching the end with picking up coins during the run.

pages.title: Black Star Pinball
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description:
Black Star Pinball gives you one ball and two very different kinds of star. Hit yellow stars before their time runs out, but avoid black stars: touching one destroys the pinball and ends the game. Letting a yellow star's timer expire also ends the attempt.

Use the arrow keys or mouse to play. Dropping the ball is another way to lose, so you need to keep it in play while choosing which targets to approach. Collect as many yellow stars as you can without letting the ball reach a black one.

pages.title: Jungle Highway Escape
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description:
Jungle Highway Escape puts a car on the wrong side of a highway and asks you to keep it going while collecting coins. Steer along the road and pick up the coins to increase your score.

You can control the car with the arrow keys or WASD. Mouse and touch controls are also available. Watch the road ahead while choosing your direction so that you can guide the car toward the next coins along the route.

pages.title: Zombo
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description:
Zombo is a zombie shooter that combines gunfire with jumping. Use A to fire at the zombies and the Up arrow to jump, keeping the character ready to deal with the enemies along the route.

Watch the next zombie before choosing when to shoot, and use jumps as part of moving through the encounter. The game's focus is continuing the fight against the undead while managing those two actions.

pages.title: Ninja the Frog
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description:
Ninja the Frog asks you to guide a jumping frog through an escape filled with enemies. Click or tap to control its jumps, collecting food while keeping away from the creatures in its path.

Look at the space ahead before the next jump so that the frog can reach food without moving into an enemy. The challenge connects timing the movement with choosing a clear way through the escape.

pages.title: Russian Trucks Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Russian Trucks Differences shows pairs of truck pictures with seven changes to find in each pair. Click or tap the details that differ, comparing the two images before choosing a location.

There are ten levels, and each gives you one minute to locate all seven differences. Search the truck and the surrounding details systematically so that you can keep track of what you have already checked. Complete the current pair before the time expires to continue through the set.

pages.title: Dressed For Shopping
pages.creator: Girls Games
pages.description:
Dressed For Shopping is a fashion game about choosing an outfit before heading out to buy more clothes. Explore the teen character's wardrobe and combine its pieces into a look for her shopping trip.

Use the mouse to make selections. Her style allows combinations such as a dress with sneakers and large accessories, giving you room to mix dressier clothing with casual pieces. Try the wardrobe's options together as you decide how she should look for the outing.

pages.title: Basketball Swooshes
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description:
Basketball Swooshes is a one-on-one shooting contest about making baskets faster and more accurately than your opponent. Aim the ball toward the hoop and take the next shot, adjusting your direction as you try to outscore the other player.

On a computer, move the mouse pointer to aim and click the left button to shoot. On mobile, touch and drag to aim, then release to throw. Judge the shot before releasing so that speed still leaves room for an accurate finish.

pages.title: Traffic Rider
pages.creator: Hitgames.org
pages.description:
Traffic Rider puts you on a motorcycle in busy road traffic. Steer through the vehicles and try to improve your score, using WASD to control the bike. Motorcycle modification gives you another way to develop your ride.

Watch the space between the traffic ahead before choosing your path. The task is keeping the motorcycle moving through the busy road while working toward a better scoring run.

pages.title: GL Luxuxy Offroad Vehicles Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description:
GL Luxuxy Offroad Vehicles Puzzle is a jigsaw collection featuring six vehicle pictures. Choose an image and its piece count, then use the mouse to assemble the photograph from its fragments.

Each picture offers four sizes: sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four or one hundred pieces. Pick the size you want to solve and compare the fragments with the vehicle image as you reconstruct it. Changing the piece count lets you revisit the same photograph with a different amount of assembly work.

pages.title: BTS Cartoon Coloring Time
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
BTS Cartoon Coloring Time gives you cartoon pictures to paint with a choice of colors. Select an image, choose the color you want to use and work on the drawing with the brush.

Use the mouse or touch screen to play. Move between colors as you fill the picture, choosing which parts should share a shade and which should stand out. The activity centers on creating your own colored version of the selected cartoon image.

pages.title: Knight in Love
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description:
Knight in Love follows a knight trying to rescue the princess from a dragon. Attack the castle and collect gold, then use your earnings to improve the knight's weapon and equipment.

Mouse clicks or taps control the movement and upgrades. Work toward stronger equipment as you continue the assault, connecting the gold you collect with the improvements needed for the rescue. The castle attack and equipment progression form the central loop of the knight's adventure.

pages.title: Wild Memory
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description:
Wild Memory is a matching game with cards showing wild animals. Find cards with the same animal and pair them, working through the set until all the matches are complete.

A tutorial introduces the activity. Keep track of the animal pictures and their positions as you search for each partner, then try to finish the collection more quickly on another attempt. The goal is completing the whole matching set.

pages.title: Become a Fashion Designer
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description:
Become a Fashion Designer lets you put together clothing designs for different occasions. Choose what kind of outfit to create, with options ranging from everyday clothes to party wear, prom dresses and princess gowns.

Combine the available styles with prints, patterns and accessories to develop the design's appearance. Think about the occasion while choosing which elements to use together, then try another combination when you want a different result. The game focuses on coordinating those design choices into your own finished outfit.

pages.title: Flappy Cube Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description:
Flappy Cube Challenge asks you to keep a small green cube flying as far as possible. Tap anywhere to lift it, collecting food for extra points while steering clear of obstacles and the black bird.

Letting the cube fall or collide with an obstacle ends the attempt. Watch the height of the next opening before tapping again so that the cube can keep flying through the route. Food offers extra scoring opportunities when you can reach it without meeting a hazard.

pages.title: Blocks Battle
pages.creator: Gamebuilt.com
pages.description:
Blocks Battle is a falling-block puzzle with a space setting. Move and rotate the shapes as they descend, fitting them into complete horizontal rows. Finished rows disappear and add to your score, opening space for the pieces still to come.

A landing preview shows where the current shape would settle, helping you judge its position before dropping it. Consecutive placements that clear rows build a combo, while gaps in the stack make further arrangements harder to complete. Look at the available spaces before choosing how to turn and place the next shape.

pages.title: Snow White Pregnancy
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description:
Snow White Pregnancy follows Snow White as she prepares for her baby. Help her shop for the items she needs, take part in the ambulance trip to the hospital and choose outfits for a photo session with the baby.

Click or use touch controls to play through the activities. The game moves between shopping, the hospital journey and dressing the characters, giving you different preparations to carry out as Snow White gets ready for the new arrival.

pages.title: Cyber Hunter
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Cyber Hunter is a post-apocalyptic shooter about fighting for the resistance against droids and cybernetic soldiers. Control the character with the mouse or arrow keys on a computer, or use touch controls on mobile, and battle the enemy forces as you work toward victory.

pages.title: Slot Car Racing
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Slot Car Racing brings miniature-track racing to solo and two-player contests. Choose Quick Race or Challenge for a solo session, with four difficulty settings available, or race against a friend across eight increasingly difficult tracks.

Click the car's controller to accelerate. Keep your attention on the track as you manage the car's speed and try to finish ahead of the opposition. The different modes let you choose between a quick contest and working through the racing challenges.

pages.title: Kardashians Graduation
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Kardashians Graduation puts you in charge of graduation looks for Kendall Jenner, Kylie Jenner, Khloe Kardashian and Kim Kardashian. Help the four characters prepare for their celebration, choosing the style you want each of them to wear. Work through their different looks as you get the group ready for graduation day.

pages.title: 2018 College Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description:
2018 College Fun is a dress-up game about helping a group of girls choose outfits. They want fashion advice before seeing their boyfriends, and your task is to find dresses that suit the looks you have in mind.

Compare the available dress choices and decide what each character should wear. The activity centers on preparing their appearance and putting together the outfits they want for the occasion.

pages.title: Jump to the core
pages.creator: Dob5 Games
pages.description:
Jump to the core is a jumping challenge about reaching the center of the planet. Work through six levels while keeping away from monsters and dangerous rolling rocks along the route.

Watch where the rocks move before attempting the next section, since they can cause heavy damage. Your goal is to keep progressing toward the core while finding a way past the creatures and hazards that stand between you and the center.

pages.title: Find The Candy Kids Room
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description:
Find The Candy Kids Room hides a sweet treat and three stars in each level. Search the room by interacting with objects and the friendly characters, working out how to uncover the candy and locate every star.

The puzzles become more demanding as you continue. Examine the objects around a hidden area and consider how they might help with the search. Each level combines finding small details with using the room's interactions to reveal the treat you are looking for.

pages.title: Miss Halloween Princess
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description:
Miss Halloween Princess helps Ariel, Mulan, Tiana and Cinderella prepare costumes for trick-or-treating and a parade. Choose outfits for the four princesses, coordinating their clothes with hairstyles, shoes and accessories.

Their wardrobes offer different costume ideas. Ariel can try a Harley Quinn-inspired look, Mulan can dress as a pumpkin, and Tiana has skeleton and zombie-cheerleader options. Cinderella's choices include cupcake, cookie-monster and punk-rock styles. Matching particular clothing pieces with accessories also unlocks achievements. Work through the princesses and build the Halloween look you want each to wear for the costume event.

pages.title: Fantasy Heroes
pages.creator: Ixel Games
pages.description:
Fantasy Heroes puts three heroes in charge of defending a castle from troll hordes. Use their attacks to defeat the approaching enemies, keeping track of the trolls pressing toward the castle.

Reload the magic to prepare a powerful attack when the enemy pressure grows. The challenge combines reacting to the hordes with choosing when to use that stronger response. Keep the three defenders fighting as you try to overcome the trolls threatening their castle.

pages.title: Microbius
pages.creator: Zenkay Games
pages.description:
Microbius is an arena game about growing a cell by feeding. Guide it toward pellets to gain mass, then absorb smaller cells while keeping away from opponents large enough to consume you.

Use the mouse to direct your movement around the arena. Your size affects encounters with other cells, so consider their relative size before approaching them. The score display tracks your progress as you work toward becoming a larger presence in the arena.

pages.title: Swimming Pro
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description:
Swimming Pro puts you into swimming races with opponents to beat and times to improve. Use the Left and Right arrow keys to control the swimmer as you compete for a place on the podium.

Medals contribute to increasing your energy, giving you a progression goal alongside each race result. Work on a faster performance while collecting medals and trying to move ahead of the other swimmers.

pages.title: BrickZ
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description:
BrickZ puts you in control of a chain that grows when you collect additional balls. Guide it through the brick arrangements and break bricks to build your score, choosing a route that lets you keep developing the chain.

Swipe with a finger or use the mouse to steer. Look at the layout ahead and decide which bricks to approach while reaching for more balls. The task connects controlling the chain's path with growing it and breaking as many bricks as you can.
